assets.tool: Claude (SVG rects written by tools/pixel_grid.py from a character grid, the grid by a small generator)
assets.prompt: A 48x48 room exit seen from above (transparent background), dark: a flat square floor plate of carved stone with bevelled corners and an Outline edge, a raised rim shaded as a bevel (Stone light at the top-left, Stone shadow at the bottom-right), a Stone base face with a carved line and three small carved cross runes on each side, and a sunken sealed well in the middle (Stone shadow worn with thin Outline streaks) round a carved diamond sigil in Stone base. Only rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md.
